core_obligations: Reconcile the fibre-theoretic and ring-theoretic formulations of regularity.
Pass between the global formulations and the affine cover conditions, verifying the equivalence of all five.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the morphism formulation with flatness plus geometrically regular fibres.
Reduce the ring-map conditions to affine opens.
Show the cover conditions are equivalent to the global ones.

difficulty_reason: The lemma records five equivalent formulations of the regularity of a morphism: the morphism itself, flatness with geometrically regular fibres, the ring-map condition on every compatible pair of affine opens, the same condition on an open cover, and the condition on an affine open cover. The proof reconciles the global formulations with the ring-theoretic one by localising and using that regularity is checked on affine opens, so the content is the assembly of the local conditions into the global ones. Retained author proof at lines 5701-5733.
